parameters.content:
## Setup
1. Edit **Watch Configuration**.
2. Test the fetch/parser manually.
3. Activate the workflow so scheduled production runs persist state.
4. Replace the generic alert webhook with your preferred notification node if desired.

The first successful production observation becomes the baseline and does not alert.
